settings.text: Here you'll find new & restored cameras, lenses, and accessories, shipping from our store in Tampa, Florida. Inventory moves fast, if you see something you want, buy it quickly!

settings.heading: Do these used cameras have a warranty?
settings.row_content:
All cameras not rated "as-is" carry a 90 day replacement warranty. This does not include damage caused by you, and our liability is limited replacing the camera with a comparable model from our inventory.

For more information about our used equipment warranty, please visit Used Camera Equipment Grading System & Limited Warranty Statement

settings.heading: What is your grading system and how does it work?
settings.row_content:
Our used cameras are graded from "Mint" to "AS-IS" so you know exactly what you're getting:

  • Mint: Like new, with no noticeable wear and tear. Works perfectly.
  • Excellent: Some signs of use, but works perfectly. May have minor cosmetic blemishes.
  • Good: More noticeable wear and tear, but fully functional. May have minor cosmetic or internal lens imperfections.
  • One-Off: More noticeable wear and tear. Missing some functions (listed in the description).
  • As-Is: Untested, non-functional, or damaged. May not work. No returns.

    All cameras except "As-Is" come with a 90-day warranty.

For more information about our used equipment grading system, please visit Used Camera Equipment Grading System & Limited Warranty Statement

settings.heading: Where do you source your camera gear from?
settings.row_content: Our camera equipment comes from a very diverse range of sources. Most items are directly purchased from the original owners who have lovingly cared for them over the years and are simply ready for them to find new owners who will enjoy them. Additionally, we do source hard to find cameras directly from used camera stores in Japan and Europe for items that are hard to find in the states. Our global network of experienced camera hunters seek out hidden gems, looking for the most interesting cameras they can find for our store. With all these sources combined we're able to offer a vast range of cameras to fit almost any taste!

settings.heading: Why buy here when I can find it cheaper on eBay?
settings.row_content:
What sets us apart from other sellers is that we see every camera sale as the start of a new relationship. We're passionate about supporting your film photography journey.

This starts with being meticulous about the cameras, lenses, and accessories we sell. Our 20-point inspection protocol goes far beyond a quick battery check. We ensure each camera functions as the factory intended.

Additionally, most of our inventory is deep cleaned and serviced. This ensures it works when you receive it and for years to come.

We're first and foremost a film lab—we want you to shoot as much film as possible!
